# `company.price_rules`

Price rules: conditions, an adjustment and rounding that price matching sales lines (Advanced Pricing).

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Stable ULID of this record. |
| `version` | INTEGER | no | 1 | — | — | — | Optimistic-concurrency version of this record. |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC timestamp when this record was created. |
| `created_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | User id recorded as creating this record. |
| `created_via` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Interface recorded for creation of this record. |
| `updated_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC timestamp of the latest update to this record. |
| `updated_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | User id recorded for the latest update to this record. |
| `updated_via` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Interface recorded for the latest update to this record. |
| `name` | VARCHAR(200) | no | — | — | — | — | Rule name as entered, such as Acme pipe fittings 10% off. |
| `name_key` | VARCHAR(400) | no | — | unique | — | — | NFC-normalized, trimmed and case-folded name; unique within the company. |
| `description` | VARCHAR(500) | yes | — | — | — | — | What the rule is for, as the person wrote it. |
| `active` | BOOLEAN | no | true | — | — | — | Whether the rule prices new lines; an inactive rule is kept for history. |
| `priority` | INTEGER | no | — | — | — | — | Order among rules, 1 first; ties go to the name, then the id. |
| `date_from` | VARCHAR(10) | yes | — | — | — | — | First transaction date, YYYY-MM-DD, the rule applies to; null for no start. |
| `date_to` | VARCHAR(10) | yes | — | — | — | — | Last transaction date, YYYY-MM-DD, the rule applies to; null for no end. |
| `min_quantity_microunits` | BIGINT | yes | — | — | — | — | Smallest line quantity in base units, in millionths, the rule applies to; null for any. |
| `conditions` | TEXT | no | — | — | — | — | Canonical JSON of the id lists the line must match: items, item_categories, customers, customer_types, classes, sales_reps; an empty list matches all. |
| `adjustment_kind` | VARCHAR(8) | no | — | — | — | — | percent or amount. |
| `direction` | VARCHAR(8) | no | — | — | — | — | down (a discount) or up (a markup). |
| `basis` | VARCHAR(12) | no | — | — | — | — | sales_price (the item price) or cost (the item cost) the adjustment starts from. |
| `value` | BIGINT | yes | — | — | — | — | Percent in millionths of a point, or amount in minor units; null when quantity breaks give the value. |
| `breaks` | TEXT | yes | — | — | — | — | Canonical JSON quantity breaks [{min_quantity_microunits, value}] ascending; null for one value. |
| `rounding` | VARCHAR(8) | no | — | — | — | — | cent (to the cent), x.99, x.95 (up to the next price ending so) or dollar (nearest whole unit). |
